dailyTarot.eyebrow: With Yeoni · Destiny Tea House cards · once a day
dailyTarot.title: Three cards to open your day
dailyTarot.subtitle: While the tea steeps, listen to your heart for a moment.
dailyTarot.freeHint: Free, no sign-in needed. New cards arrive once a day.
dailyTarot.aboutBody: Destiny Tea House cards read your heart, your flow and one small action. It is a symbolic tarot reading, separate from saju, sukuyo, Vedic or numerology calculations.
dailyTarot.guide2Body: Choose the cards your heart lingers on. You can change them before they are turned.
dailyTarot.guide3Body: The three cards open one by one, followed by the reading.
dailyTarot.pickTitle: Pick three cards your heart lingers on
dailyTarot.pickHint: Tap a picked card again to undo it.
dailyTarot.revealHint: Tap a card to turn the rest at once.
dailyTarot.readingTitle: Weaving the story of the three cards
dailyTarot.verdictLabel: Today · the conclusion of all three cards
dailyTarot.fallbackQuote: “You do not have to answer all three cards. One thing that stays with you today is enough.”
dailyTarot.fallbackNote: The full reading could not be loaded. Reopen the page to read it again.
dailyTarot.paidTitle: Want to go deeper with your own question?
dailyTarot.paidBody: This free reading looks at the structure of the cards. At the tea house you can write a question and draw three new cards, and Yeoni will read them at length for your situation. One follow-up question is included.
dailyTarot.endingNote: You can reread these cards today. Three new cards will be waiting tomorrow.
dailyTarot.sharedBody: Only the card symbols were shared, with no personal details or question.
dailyTarot.newDayBody: A new day has come. Set the old cards aside and spread today's three cards.
dailyTarot.storageNote: This browser cannot save, so you can only see the result during this visit.

healingTarot.title: Today's recovery energy
healingTarot.subtitle: From where your heart grew tired to one recovery action for today, four cards light the way.
healingTarot.aboutBody: Four cards from the 78-card deck read where your heart grew tired, the temperature of your feelings, a clue to recovery and a recovery action for today.
healingTarot.guide1Body: All 78 cards are shuffled and four are drawn.
healingTarot.guide2Body: The cards open one by one in position order.
healingTarot.guide3Body: See a reading for each card and a recovery routine for today.
healingTarot.revealHint: Tap a card to turn the rest at once.
